annotations.title: Open Plan a day in Headed Back

description: A link that opens the free Headed Back app on the person's phone, where Plan a day (Play > Explore) builds a Florida day on a mood (beach, Old Florida, rainy day, wild Florida, weird and cool, road trip) and a start time. Use it at the end of a Florida day plan.

start.description: early 8 AM, mid 10 AM, late noon
